data.text: task list --search on the engine: 1182 tests green; task list --search end to end 110-120 ms on this journal. Behaviour change worth knowing: a fragment no longer matches (coo does not find cookie), and a multi-word search finds tasks holding enough of the question, not only those holding the exact phrase - a fixture of eight 'Cookie banner' tasks came back as nine because another task mentioned cookie. The cost ladder is in the AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md section (25 lines, 1436 bytes) and in .kadence/README.md for new repositories; an existing .kadence/README.md is never rewritten by init, so this repository's copy does not have it (the gap KAD-52 noted).
